feeds.title: The Fabric Store Blog
feeds.description: At the Fabric Store, we are simply lovers of fabric. We are a destination point for the sewing and creative community, offering a curated range of designer dress fabrics and mill overruns coupled with an exceptional in-store experience and dedicated, passionate service. Our aim is to provide an alternative option within a fast-fashion society where fine craft and high quality fabrics are often undervalued.

feeds.title: Cathy Jack Coupland Blog
feeds.description: My name's Cathy Jack Coupland and I'm an award-winning Australian textile artist with over 20 years of experience designing original and unique machine-embroidered artworks. Design isn't difficult, but it can be daunting, so we just have to make the whole process enjoyable and doable -and best of all -make it yours!

feeds.title: Elbe Textiles
feeds.description: Hey, I'm Lauren -the owner of Elbe Textiles. Here I am providing downloadable sewing patterns for you to be able to print off at home and make your own clothing. I'm passionate about clothing and textiles, particularly sustainable and slow fashion. I live by the ethos of 'quality over quantity'.

feeds.title: Sally Campbell Blog
feeds.description: Australian designer Sally Campbell works with skilled artisans in India to create her unique range of quilts, throws, cushions, and clothes.

feeds.title: Australiana Fabrics Blog
feeds.description: We are an Aussie family company based in regional New South Wales. Our Unique fabric designs celebrate Australia and we only offer unique and exclusive Australian-designed fabrics. We have an extensive range of koala fabrics and are super excited to announce we stock Australian Made Fabrics in our high-quality Australian fabric shop.

feeds.title: Textile Recyclers Australia Blog
feeds.description: More than just a recycling company, TRA collaborates to find circular solutions for unwanted textiles. Providing recycling solutions for fashion, uniforms, and other textiles whilst creating 'closed loop' programs one garment at a time.

feeds.title: Instyle Blog
feeds.description: Instyle is a wholesale supplier of high-quality textiles, leathers, wallcoverings + acoustic solutions made with integrity, born in Australia, represented and inspired globally.

feeds.title: Musing in Textile
feeds.description: I am a Textile Artist and itinerant at the moment. My base at present is in Gellibrand though I teach around the world. I love to dye and print fabrics and assemble them into quilts with lots of stitching both by hand and machine. I also create my own linocuts for printing on fabric.

feeds.title: So - Meru Blog
feeds.description: Australian Textile Artist Melinda Heal talks about her journey of exploring Japan's textile culture and shares her new discoveries and developments. Melinda is a double graduate in textile and Japanese and is very passionate about Katazome - a Japanese technique of stencil-resist dyeing. Read her musings and conversations here.

feeds.title: Kirsten Katz Blog
feeds.description: Explore the life of Kirsten Katz, an Australian artist and designer. This blog documents her journey as an artist and surface designer and shares her designs, showing her style, concepts, design process, and inspirations.
